name: Influenza A target-cell-limited model with an eclipse phase (TEIV)
description:
Influenza A within-host dynamics in experimentally infected humans.
Four compartments, no target-cell regeneration and no host death terms — over a 7–10 day infection, target-cell depletion alone terminates the infection, which is the model's central claim.
Parameter values: 0 of 6 checked against the source; the rest are recalled or illustrative.
reference: Baccam P, Beauchemin C, Macken CA, Hayden FG, Perelson AS (2006). Kinetics of influenza A virus infection in humans. Journal of Virology 80(15):7590–7599

compartments.name: I1
compartments.description: infected cells in the eclipse phase (not yet producing virus)

compartments.name: V
compartments.description: infectious virus titre (TCID50 per mL of nasal wash)

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: rate of transition from eclipse to productively infected [unverified] (per day)

parameters.name: delta

parameters.name: p

parameters.name: cV
parameters.description: viral clearance rate (secondary source: 0.125 per hour = 3.0 per day) [unverified] (per day)

variables.name: R0v
variables.description: within-host basic reproductive ratio, with Tc0 the initial target-cell count (this expression for R0 is confirmed in the derived literature)
